dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Work done without error is work well done.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, other than the occasional racket the Autostamper 3000 makes, everything else is going quite alright.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: It's quieter when Mr. Thales isn't around, really, like a dog tied to a post in front of a cafe.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You see, even the most energetic little creatures know that a little rest will allow one to run further the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The day is so lively with the youngsters around and the night seems ever more quiet by comparison.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Good evening, Traveler. Seems like you've had a rather busy day yourself, hmm? Just like Mr. Iaune.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You do seem a lot happier than he does, though.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: He's too passionate, and that exhausts him. This is quite common in the young, and they'll need some time to adjust.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Semaine and I will keep an eye on him.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: See you, then. Tomorrow will be another lovely day.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Well said. It could be a motto.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Cornelia just brought some refreshments, please be my guest and have some.
